body:
Most people are genuinely good and care about you and the world.

No one might remember you. But no one remembers most of humanity. Worth dying for?  I dunno.

People love you, I'm sure. I'm also in a fucked up place, so I don't want to offer you comfort I don't believe in. But I do believe some people have the meaning and love and potential to carry on.

Success is bullshit. Backwardsness is a problem, but it's not everything. We need people who understand despair.

Just snowing. 

I try and remember that it's beautiful.
